visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white knitted cardigan, stands in front of a white brick wall and a yellow sofa. She holds a smartphone displaying a pink-themed widget home screen and points to it with an excited facial expression and a broad smile. (2) The scene transitions to a screen recording of the Apple App Store. A search for 'top widgets' is performed, and the user selects the app with a colorful icon, showing the download page. (3) The app opens with a splash screen reading 'TOP WIDGETS+,' followed by a brief red advertisement. The user dismisses the ad to reveal a grid of various widget styles. (4) The user scrolls through the 'Hot Widgets' library, passing categories like 'Love House' and 'MALTESE.' They view several minimalist white and black calendar widgets with cute illustrations. (5) A search is entered for '线条小狗' (Line Art Dog) using a Chinese keyboard. A variety of illustrated dog-themed widgets in pastel pink, yellow, and blue appear. (6) A specific pink widget featuring a cartoon dog and a drink is selected for customization. The user toggles through different background colors, font styles, and border designs to personalize the widget. (7) Returning to the iPhone home screen which features a white bunny wallpaper, the user enters 'jiggle mode' and searches for 'Top Widgets' to add a new small-sized widget. (8) The final setup is shown with three different widgets applied to the home screen. The presenter reappears on screen, holding the phone and speaking directly to the camera with a cheerful demeanor.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你不可能不喜歡. [Logo]: @aottergirls. (2) [Subtitle]: 這麼可愛的桌面小工具吧. (3) [Subtitle]: 我一定要教你. (4) [Subtitle]: 首先先把 Top Widgets 這個 App 下載好後打開. (5) [Subtitle]: 通常有小廣告看一下就好. (6) [Subtitle]: 之後在 Popular 這一行往旁邊滑. (7) [Subtitle]: 有可愛的 MALTESE 出現就對了. (8) [Subtitle]: 往下滑有超多可以挑. (9) [Subtitle]: 或是用簡體中文搜尋線條小狗. (10) [Subtitle]: 還會有更多更有創意的款式、小工具可以選哦. (11) [Subtitle]: 選一個你想使用的之後還能編輯背景顏色變換字體、邊框. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後一樣看個小廣告解鎖有些款式可以不用看. (13) [Slogan]: 再按新增. (14) [Subtitle]: 回到桌面長按看到左上角編輯加入小工具選 Top Widget 按加入. (15) [Subtitle]: 再點開然後按 Current 這個就能選擇剛剛做好的囉. (16) [Variety]: 超級可愛. (17) [Subtitle]: 但是比較介意有簡體字的人就要特別避開. (18) [Subtitle]: 也可能會稍微耗電快去試試吧手機再也不枯燥.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins the audio track with high energy and a friendly, animated tone. An upbeat background pop/electronic track with a fast tempo (approx 120 BPM) and bright synthesizer textures plays at a moderate volume. (2) As the app store interaction starts, the speaker's vocal tempo remains rapid, explaining the download steps. A distinct digital 'click' sound effect is heard as the app is opened, following a short percussive rhythm in the music. (3) During the app navigation, the speaker maintains high articulation clarity. The background music remains steady with a constant rhythmic kick drum. A faint notification-like chime plays when a specific widget category is selected. (4) As customization begins, the speaker's tone remains comedic and enthusiastic. The background music features a subtle synth riser effect during the transition between menus. The recording environment is clean with no audible ambient floor. (5) During the setup phase on the home screen, the vocal delivery becomes informative. A series of soft tap sounds and percussive 'pop' effects are heard as items are placed, synchronized with the user's manual actions. (6) The video concludes with a high-valence vocal summary. The speaker uses a rising intonation for emphasis on the final sentence. The background music maintains its intensity until the final second, ending with a clean hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a quick tutorial to teach users how to use the 'Top Widgets' app for smartphone home screen customization. By demonstrating the variety of cute animal-themed designs and providing a step-by-step guide on how to download and apply them, the creator encourages viewers to personalize their devices.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The presenter explicitly names the 'Top Widgets' app, shows the download process, and provides a tutorial on how to use its features.
